name: SLGC Berhad
overview: SLGC Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE Market 上市，首次公开募股（IPO）发行105,000,000股新股。公司业务线未发生扩张、缩减或退出，亦未公告新合约。
overview_en: SLGC Berhad was listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026 through an initial public offering (IPO) of 105,000,000 new ordinary shares. There were no expansions, reductions, or exits of business lines, and no new contracts announced.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在ACE Market上市，业务线未发生变动。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026, with no changes to its business lines.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") C
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股，公开发行105,000,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE Market上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering of 105,000,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia.
